# Pragmatism Is a Method Only[^1]

At the same time pragmatism does not stand for any special results. It is a method only. But the general triumph of that method would mean an enormous change in the 'temperament' of philosophy. Teachers of the ultra-rationalistic type would be frozen out. Science and metaphysics would come much nearer together, would in fact work absolutely hand in hand.

[^1]: [[@Pragmatism - William James]]
